note: Migration #011 (items.restock_interval_days + items.last_stocked_at -- INVENTORY-DESIGN step 5, user-set restock cadence). Adds two nullable columns to the existing items table: no new table and no new rows, so the only row-count change is the schema_version record itself. Inventory never touches money, so the who-owes-whom balance and every monthly total are identical; they are deliberately absent from this list.
